evidenceNotes: Findings cite repository evidence or deterministic probes. No human pilot data, customer feedback or market research exists; none is asserted. Model calls during audit: 0 ($0.00).

findings.problem: Runtime safety fragments are exact phrases from 42 eval cases; paraphrased unsupported commitments pass as SAFE while legitimate grounded sentences are held.
findings.evidence: Probe on pre-audit code: 0/7 paraphrases ('We'll refund', 'I will refund', 'We will credit', 'We can waive', 'We guarantee', curly apostrophe) detected; 3/5 legitimate sentences ('24 months', 'from today', 'by post') returned MANUAL_REVIEW.
findings.recommendation: Generic commitment tier (done, hold-only) plus a grounded-commitment check against retrieved documents and a 100+ real-output labelled corpus.

findings.problem: A MANUAL_REVIEW or VIOLATION outcome discards the analysis; the agent gets an error and nothing to review.
findings.evidence: runCaseAnalysis returns an error/manualReview message and persists nothing. Follow-up 2026-10-08: held analyses are now stored with safety_status=manual_review, shown flagged, copy gated by acknowledgement (migration 0003); VIOLATION still rejected.
findings.recommendation: Persist held analyses with safety_status and fragments, show with a banner, require acknowledgement before copy; keep VIOLATION rejected. Amends the Phase 8 contract and needs owner sign-off.

findings.problem: ASCII-only tokenizer split accented words and produced no keywords for non-Latin text; retrieval quality is unmeasured above 33 documents.
findings.evidence: tokenize('cancelación') -> ['cancelaci','n']; Thai input -> []. Phase 6 retrieval 41/41 on a 33-document KB.
findings.recommendation: Unicode-aware tokenizer (done); recall@5 benchmark on a larger KB; Postgres full-text before any agent; word segmentation for Thai/CJK only if the market needs it.

findings.problem: Empty retrieval returns an error before any triage; out-of-KB cases get no help.
findings.evidence: runCaseAnalysis: retrievedDocs.length === 0 returns an error. The prompt already instructs behaviour for empty knowledge. Follow-up 2026-10-08: empty retrieval now stores a deterministic no-coverage escalation (no model call); tests and audit E2E #9.
findings.recommendation: Coverage 'none' produces a deterministic escalation result without invention.

findings.problem: Confidence is shown as a prominent bar although it is not calibrated.
findings.evidence: Phase 7: 4 wrong answers at confidence 0.9; threshold not usable as a gate.
findings.recommendation: Caption added ('self-reported, not a measure of correctness'); consider de-emphasizing the bar after pilot data.

findings.problem: A stored draft uses live-chat register ('Please hold on for a moment while I check this') in an asynchronous reply.
findings.evidence: docs/PHASES/phase6-results.json perCase ev001; n=1 anecdote. Human review sample: 7 accept, 5 accept-with-edit, 0 reject (n=12).
findings.recommendation: Measure edit patterns in the pilot before changing the prompt; consider a draft-refinement step only if patterns are consistent.

findings.problem: Sources stored only documentId and relevance; the UI showed the current document title/version, so edited knowledge silently changed what an old analysis appeared to cite.
findings.evidence: AnalysisSource type and case page source mapping at HEAD.
findings.recommendation: Snapshot version and title at analysis time; flag drift and missing documents (done).

findings.problem: No timeout on the provider call.
findings.evidence: generateObject called without abortSignal. Phase 6 p95 latency 5.16 s, max 7.07 s.
findings.recommendation: 30 s default via AI_TIMEOUT_MS (done; type-checked, not exercised against the real provider).

findings.problem: Analyses record the model but not a prompt version, so prompt changes cannot be attributed in metrics.
findings.evidence: case_analyses has model column only.
findings.recommendation: Record a prompt version/hash on each analysis.

findings.problem: Phase 9 experiment code lives in the production path: app/ imports scripts/phase9/dataset.ts (540 lines), recordExperimentResult writes a JSON file under docs/PHASES at runtime, experiment branches in case-workspace.tsx.
findings.evidence: cases/actions.ts, cases/[id]/page.tsx, case-workspace.tsx.
findings.recommendation: Keep until the Phase 9 human pilot is run, then replace with case_events and delete.

findings.problem: Stripe/pricing/billing starter code is unused by the product.
findings.evidence: app/(dashboard)/pricing, lib/payments, webhook route; no plan model in the product.
findings.recommendation: Hide for the pilot; delete or rebuild once pricing is decided.

findings.problem: Unused dependencies and misplaced dev dependencies.
findings.evidence: Zero imports of postgres, autoprefixer, @neon/env; @types/* and drizzle-kit under dependencies.
findings.recommendation: Unused removed (done); move @types/* and drizzle-kit to devDependencies.

findings.problem: Case statuses 'approved' and 'failed' are never set.
findings.evidence: grep: only 'queued' (default) and 'resolved' are written.
findings.recommendation: Remove or implement.

findings.problem: E2E created active documents in a team whose knowledge the AI retrieves; 15 duplicates of 'E2E Guide: Handling Refund Requests' accumulated in Test Team.
findings.evidence: DB query: team 1 active documents 47, of which 15 E2E duplicates; 13 more drafts in the Isolation team.
findings.recommendation: Phase 3 E2E now deletes the documents it creates; legacy duplicates set to draft (reversible) because older analyses may cite them.

findings.problem: No indexes beyond primary keys; the list query loaded every historical analysis of every case.
findings.evidence: schema.ts at HEAD; getCasesForTeam.
findings.recommendation: Add composite indexes and DISTINCT ON latest analysis (done; migration 0002 applied to the shared dev database).

findings.problem: ROADMAP.md said 'Phase 8+ not defined' although Phase 8 and 9 reports exist; DevRunbook.md said Phase 4 pending.
findings.evidence: docs/ROADMAP.md, DevRunbook.md at HEAD.
findings.recommendation: Make living docs consistent; leave historical reports untouched (done).

findings.problem: Full users row (including passwordHash) and full teams row (Stripe ids) were serialized into every page payload and returned by /api/user and /api/team.
findings.evidence: app/api/user/route.ts and app/layout.tsx (SWRConfig fallback) returned getUser()/getTeamForUser() rows. After the fix: /api/user keys = id,name,email,role; page HTML has no passwordHash/Stripe field; e2e/audit.spec.ts tests 7-8.
findings.recommendation: Client-safe projections for everything crossing the server/client boundary.

findings.problem: Customer PII is sent to the AI provider unredacted; no processor agreement/retention position; no way to delete a case.
findings.evidence: lib/ai/provider.ts sends the full case text; no delete-case action or retention setting exists. Applicable jurisdictions are an assumption requiring validation.
findings.recommendation: Decide data-protection position and add case deletion before using real customer data; synthetic/consenting data is unaffected.

findings.problem: One shared Neon database (.neon branch 'production') serves development, E2E, evaluation teams and would serve a pilot; E2E writes to it.
findings.evidence: .neon, DevRunbook.md section 1, e2e specs using POSTGRES_URL directly; DB query showed 15 active duplicate E2E documents in Test Team and E2E case_events. Follow-up 2026-10-08: Neon branches dev/pilot created, .env points to dev, docs/DATABASE-ENVIRONMENTS.md; pilot branch emptied with owner approval (0 users/teams/cases/documents).
findings.recommendation: Dedicated pilot database/branch and team; run E2E on a throwaway branch; CI.

findings.problem: No rate limiting or lockout on sign-in/sign-up.
findings.evidence: No rate-limit logic in app/(login)/actions.ts.
findings.recommendation: Per-IP/account throttle on authentication actions.

findings.problem: Authorization is team membership only; any member can edit the KB, resolve cases and re-run analyses.
findings.evidence: knowledge/actions.ts and cases/actions.ts check team only; only invitations check the owner role.
findings.recommendation: Optional owner-only KB publish/edit.

findings.problem: AI hold/violation fragments are logged with the case id and there is no structured audit log of who edited knowledge or resolved cases.
findings.evidence: cases/actions.ts console.warn of fragments (AI output phrases, not customer text); activity_logs table only covers starter account events.
findings.recommendation: Audit-log knowledge edits and case state changes.

findings.problem: .env contains unrelated provider variable names (CMA_AI_*) from another project.
findings.evidence: Variable names only were inspected; values were not read. File is git-ignored.
findings.recommendation: Remove unrelated secrets from this project's env file.

findings.problem: Next.js pinned to canary 15.6.0-canary.59; middleware convention deprecated (build warning).
findings.evidence: package.json; build output.
findings.recommendation: Move to a patched stable release and rename middleware to proxy when available.

findings.problem: Phase 2 E2E was failing at HEAD (hard-coded 21 cases; 42 present) and silently skipped 8 dependent tests.
findings.evidence: Playwright run: 1 failed, 8 did not run, 1 passed before changes.
findings.recommendation: Count the seeded set excluding experiment/audit prefixes (done).

findings.problem: E2E suite is non-hermetic: mutates a shared database, depends on server mode (Phase 4-failure/Phase 8), and Phase 2 test 6 consumes a seeded queued case each run.
findings.evidence: Spec headers and mode.sh runs (three server restarts for Phase 8/4-failure).
findings.recommendation: Throwaway database per run, per-run unique data, one command that boots the right server mode.

findings.problem: No CI; unit tests are bespoke tsx scripts without a runner; new event actions have no dedicated cross-tenant test.
findings.evidence: No CI configuration in the repository; package.json test:unit chain.
findings.recommendation: CI running typecheck, unit tests and build; migrate scripts to node:test; add cross-tenant tests for event actions.

findings.problem: No way to create a case; cases existed only through seed/scripts.
findings.evidence: No create route or server action in app/(dashboard)/dashboard/cases at HEAD fa1e346.
findings.recommendation: Case intake form (paste subject, email, message) that lands in the workspace.

findings.problem: The draft response (the core output) sat about 1,236 px down a 720 px viewport; copy and resolve beyond 1,500 px.
findings.evidence: Measured via DOM before the change; after: draft heading at y=525 of 900 on desktop; mobile order message, recommendation, draft; no horizontal overflow; e2e/audit.spec.ts test 3.
findings.recommendation: Two-column desktop layout with the answer beside the evidence (done).

findings.problem: Cases list was an unfiltered dump (42 rows, 21 resolved experiment cases) without urgency or ordering by need.
findings.evidence: Browser at HEAD; getCasesForTeam.
findings.recommendation: Open/Resolved/All filter, open-first ordering, urgency column (done); search, assignee and pagination remain.

findings.problem: Re-run silently replaced an edited draft; drafts are not persisted across navigation.
findings.evidence: useEffect on analysis.createdAt reset the draft state.
findings.recommendation: Confirm before replacing edits (done); autosave drafts later.

findings.problem: No lead/manager view: blocked-analysis reasons, copy-unedited rate and handling time are only available via a script.
findings.evidence: No insights page; pnpm db:pilot-metrics prints from case_events.
findings.recommendation: Read-only insights page over case_events.

findings.problem: KB documents are created one by one through a form; only draft/active status; version is a bare counter without history.
findings.evidence: knowledge/actions.ts, schema documents table.
findings.recommendation: Bulk import (paste/markdown/CSV), archived status, version history.

findings.problem: Sidebar renders a button inside a link; numeric 'relevance' is meaningless to agents.
findings.evidence: app/(dashboard)/dashboard/layout.tsx; Phase 4 E2E asserts the word 'relevance'.
findings.recommendation: Use link styling directly; hide the number once E2E is adjusted.

findings.problem: A React hydration warning was logged on the old cases table in dev.
findings.evidence: Console error observed on the original markup; not reproducible after the rewrite; root cause not isolated.
findings.recommendation: Watch for recurrence; no action.

findings.problem: Starter template content: landing page marketing and fake terminal, tab title 'Next.js SaaS Starter', header 'ACME'.
findings.evidence: app/(dashboard)/page.tsx, terminal.tsx, app/layout.tsx.
findings.recommendation: Replace with product copy that makes no unproven claim (done).

findings.problem: No human timing data exists; no productivity, acceptance-rate or ROI claim is supportable.
findings.evidence: Phase 9 report: MECHANICS-VALIDATED, PILOT PENDING; phase9-agent-value-results.json does not exist.
findings.recommendation: Run the Phase 9 two-arm experiment with a pre-agreed decision rule; use case_events for live-use measurement.

agents.purpose: Produce the validated, grounded case analysis, recommended action and draft in one call.
Cheap structured hints before the model call: empty/short text, order-reference presence, likely PII, language hint.
agents.responsibility: Understand and describe the incoming case without a model.

agents.purpose: Route cases across queues/teams and assess urgency with a model.
agents.responsibility: Primary/secondary intents, urgency, required information, routing decision; must not invent policy or take actions.
agents.status: DEFER (no queues or assignees to route to)

agents.role: Knowledge / Research Agent (K1) and deterministic retrieval + coverage (D2)
agents.purpose: Find the right internal knowledge, surface conflicts and gaps, distinguish authoritative documents from customer claims.
agents.responsibility: D2 (deterministic) exists; K1 (LLM query rewriting, conflict and gap report) only if recall fails on a larger KB.
tools: search_knowledge(query) over this team's active documents (K1)

read: KB catalog and snippets, this team, active only

handoffs: escalation result when coverage is none

agents.purpose: Recommend the next action from the case and trusted knowledge.
agents.responsibility: Currently inside A1; separate call would add a step without a new human decision point.

agents.purpose: Adapt the validated recommendation into tone/language/brand voice using the team's accepted edits.
agents.responsibility: Customer-facing draft using only supported facts; must not override upstream safety or knowledge constraints.

agents.role: Quality / Safety - deterministic guard (D3 grounding + D4 safety, two tiers)
agents.purpose: Verify cited sources are retrieved documents and hold/reject unsupported commitments.
agents.responsibility: SAFE / MANUAL_REVIEW / VIOLATION; human review is the final authority.

agents.purpose: Second model reviewing the first model's output.
agents.responsibility: Verify consistency, unsupported claims and contradictions with a model.
agents.status: REJECT (cost, latency, shared failure modes, out of project scope)

agents.responsibility: None needed: the only orchestration is a short sequential flow inside the existing server action.
